visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a modern, brightly lit hotel bathroom. A young man with dark hair and glasses, wearing an oversized white long-sleeved tunic, stands inside a shallow wooden bathtub. He reaches out with his right hand to press a silver button on the black tiled wall. (2) Sudden cut to an outdoor theme park setting under bright daylight. The same man is now wearing a translucent clear raincoat over a brown shirt and beige shorts. He is dancing energetically, kicking his leg up, in front of a massive Pokemon-themed parade float featuring a large Pikachu and Poké Balls. (3) The scene shifts back indoors to a hotel room. A woman with long reddish-brown hair, also wearing a matching white tunic, stands in front of a mirror, adjusting her hair with both hands. The room features a neatly made bed and traditional Japanese-style sliding doors in the background. (4) Transition to the outdoor theme park. The woman, wearing a white skirt and a Pikachu headband, performs a spirited dance routine. Behind her are life-sized statues of characters from the anime 'Spy x Family' set against a European-style street background. (5) Back in the hotel room, the woman is seen sitting on the white bed linens, looking directly at the camera with a playful expression. The lighting is warm and soft. (6) The scene cuts to an outdoor area with a large 'KONG' sign. The woman dances in front of the attraction while performers in safari-themed outfits wave in the background. (7) Returning to the hotel hallway, the man stands with his arms spread wide, wearing the white tunic. The hallway has modern lighting and neutral tones. (8) Final scene outdoors at a Minion-themed area. The man, now in a black utility vest and denim cargo shorts, dances rhythmically in front of a large poster featuring a female character and a Minion. The visual rhythm is fast-paced, matching the energetic editing.
